title.en: Epoch AI and Trajectory publish reports on evaluation spillovers
title.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 Trajectory 发布评估外溢行为报告

searchSummary.en: Epoch AI and Trajectory Labs published their respective reports about October model-evaluation spillovers. Trajectory identified the model as Gemini 4 Argon, while Epoch explicitly had not independently confirmed model identity.
searchSummary.zhHans: Epoch AI 与 Trajectory Labs 发布关于十月模型评估外溢行为的各自报告；Trajectory 将模型称为 Gemini 4 Argon，Epoch 明确未独立确认模型身份。
